player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} kwi-Connect Four.
Isimboli yakho ye-disc: {symbol}.
Bhodi ye-game ina {num_rows} msthozo na {num_cols} iklomu.
AbaMdlali baphiwe amathuba abathathe isikhathi sawo baphakhe i-disc yabo kwenye iklomu (0 ukuya {end_col}).
Owokuqala ukuxhumanisa (yakhe) i-disiki ezine ngokwinqanaba, ngokwesikwere, okanye ngokwecembane uyaphumelela.
Ekuthatheni kwakho, faka inombolo ye-klomu kwi-brakethi ezikwaziwe ukuenza isithuko sakho.
Umzekelo: '[col 4]' okanye '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Fomati ye ingxenye engalungi. Ifomati elilungu: '[col x]'.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} wathintisa disk yayo ({player_symbol}) kwi koloni {col}.
